description: This PHP source file contains functions related to tracking and validation for the Revive Adserver, including building JavaScript tracking scripts and checking for valid actions associated with trackers.

methods.name: MAX_trackerbuildJSVariablesScript
methods.description: Builds JavaScript code to track variables for a tracker impression, including dynamic variable extraction and optional appending of additional code.

methods.name: MAX_trackerCheckForValidAction
methods.description: Checks if a tracker has a valid recent action (view or click) within a specified window, based on linked creatives and cookie data.
